why: Both Virtus Investment Partners and Diamond Hill Investment Group are active asset managers that (1) offer investment management products including mutual funds and separate accounts, (2) serve overlapping customer segments—individual investors reached via financial advisors/intermediaries and institutional clients—and (3) earn AUM-based management fees regulated by the SEC. The core offering (managing client money across equity, fixed income and alternative strategies in fund and account wrappers) and the core buyer (retail investors via advisors and institutions) are the same. Virtus uses a multi-boutique structure while Diamond Hill operates as a single investment manager, but that is an operational difference, not a product or customer difference. Both compete for the same mandates.
reason: Same product (investment management delivered through mutual funds, separate accounts, and other fund vehicles) and same customers (individual investors via advisors/intermediaries and institutional investors such as pensions and endowments). Both earn AUM-based management fees and are SEC-registered investment advisers.

primary_products.reason: Both offer mutual funds and ETF/account-based investment strategies across multiple asset classes. Virtus also has CLOs and variable insurance funds not evidenced for Diamond Hill, preventing a 100.

primary_services.reason: Both are fundamentally investment management service providers committed to delivering long-term investment outcomes for clients.

customer_segment.reason: Both serve individual investors (including via advisors) and institutional investors with the same value proposition of long-term investment management.

end_markets.reason: Both operate in asset management and wealth management, serving the same end markets.

business_model.reason: Both are active asset managers earning fees on managed assets. Virtus uses a multi-boutique/multi-manager model; Diamond Hill is a single-manager firm—a structural difference but the same fundamental asset management business model.

revenue_model.reason: Both earn revenue primarily through asset-based management fees on assets under management, the standard investment management revenue model.

value_chain_position.reason: Both sit at the same position in the value chain: financial intermediary/asset manager managing client capital and delivering investment returns.

geography_served.reason: Target explicitly lists international investor types (UCITS & QIAIFs), suggesting broader international reach; Diamond Hill is described primarily as US-based. Both have strong US presence.

specialization.reason: Virtus is a broad multi-boutique with many independent managers and strategies; Diamond Hill employs a single research-driven, valuation-based philosophy across a narrower set of strategies. Same broad space, different degree of specialization.

distribution_channels.reason: Both distribute through financial intermediaries/advisors to retail clients and have direct institutional client relationships.

regulatory_exposure.reason: Both are registered investment advisers subject to SEC regulation under the Investment Advisers Act and Investment Company Act.
